items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Sam Morgan in daytime. ... I went by and watched the banjo player all night. Johnny Dave [Davis] was with Sam Morgan.

ctx.x: Did Lucien . . . Louis and Paul were very famous and well-known. Did Lucien ever record or did he stay in New Orleans?
No. None of them recorded. He didn’t record. Only one or two bands recorded here. That was Sam Morgan that came through, and somebody else. I think Sharkey [Bonano]. That’s all. Maybe Louis Dumaine.

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: You'd see Chris Kelly's band, you'd see Sam Morgan's band... At that time, when I was coming up, when I was kid around 10 and 11 and 12, you'd see the Chameleon Band and you'd see the Olympia Band.

ctx.x: Well, that was quite a trip to go from here to Mobile.
Yeah. They used to go... Chris Kelly was going to play the weekend. He and Sam Morgan, they all went on the road. Every weekend they'd go to ..(?)..
